title: Analog Accuracy Risk
plain_reading: Analog math can change answers because real devices have noise, drift, and limited precision.
what_this_supports: AIHWKIT or a local adapter can estimate accuracy risk under stated chip assumptions.
what_this_does_not_prove: A simulator result does not prove the final chip or board behaves the same way.
next_actions: Run hardware-aware simulation with the selected memory assumptions.
